note.after_visit_summary: You are having a flare of your eczema (atopic dermatitis), likely due to the cold, dry air at your warehouse job. We are restarting a prescription ointment (Triumcin 0.1%) to apply to the affected areas twice daily for two weeks, then only on weekends as needed. Stop using the over-the-counter hydrocortisone. For nighttime itching that wakes you, take hydroxyzine 25 mg at bedtime as needed—it may make you sleepy, so do not drive after taking it. Continue taking your cetirizine 10 mg each morning for allergies. Moisturize regularly with a thick, fragrance-free cream or petroleum jelly, especially after lukewarm showers. Wear cotton-lined gloves at work when you can to protect your skin. If you notice oozing, yellow crusts, or develop a fever, call us right away as this could mean infection. Keep your follow-up appointment in 4 weeks on Monday, November 2nd so we can check your progress.
